typinganimation.title: Typing Animation
typinganimation.description: Smooth animations for typing in chat, commands and other text fields: new characters glide in, deleted ones drift away, and the text and cursor move fluidly.
typinganimation.config.preview.hint: Type here to try it out...
typinganimation.config.demo.text: Jumpy zombies quickly vex a brave wolf and ghast!
typinganimation.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. When off, every text field behaves exactly like vanilla.
typinganimation.config.easing.tooltip: Shape of the animation curve. Auto picks the curve that suits each style best.
typinganimation.config.durationMs.toolti: How long a new character takes to settle in.
typinganimation.config.intensity.tooltip: How far characters travel, how much they spin and how hard they bounce.
typinganimation.config.staggerMs.tooltip: Delay between characters when many appear at once, e.g. when pasting or recalling chat history.
typinganimation.config.glideMs.tooltip: How quickly shifted text catches up with its new position. Cursor glide has its own setting. 0 = instant.
typinganimation.config.smoothReflow.tool: Characters glide to their new place when the text shifts or scrolls, instead of jumping.
typinganimation.config.smoothCursor.tool: The text cursor glides to its new position instead of jumping.
typinganimation.config.animateChat.toolt: Animate typing in the chat and the command line.
typinganimation.config.animateOtherField: Animate every other single-line text field: search boxes, the anvil, world and server names and more.
Animate multi-line text boxes, such as descriptions and report comments.
typinganimation.config.optionsButton.too: Show a Typing Animation button in the Options screen. When hidden, open these settings from the mods list or edit typinganimation.json.
How long a deleted character stays visible as it animates out.
typinganimation.config.removeIntensity.t: Distance, rotation and scale of deleted characters. Independent of the appearance effect.
typinganimation.config.maxStaggerMs.tool: Maximum delay from the first to the last character when pasting or recalling text. 0 = all characters appear together.
typinganimation.config.cursorGlideMs.too: How smoothly the cursor catches up when you type, click or move with the arrow keys. Larger values glide more slowly. 0 = instant.
typinganimation.config.cursorStyle.toolt: Keep the vanilla cursor, or choose a vertical bar, underline or translucent block.
typinganimation.config.cursorColor.toolt: Use the field's original color, or give the animated cursor a personal accent color.
typinganimation.config.cursorWidth.toolt: Thickness of the bar or underline in GUI pixels. The block follows the character width.
typinganimation.config.animateSigns.tool: Animate letters and the cursor while editing normal signs and hanging signs, on either side.
typinganimation.config.onlyWhenFocused.t: Animate a field only while it has keyboard focus. Turn off to also animate updates to unfocused fields.
